concept.concept: A black cat sitting inside a carved jack-o-lantern with the phrase 'This Is My Costume' written below in a spooky serif font.
concept.audience: Cat owners who celebrate Halloween and enjoy humorous pet-themed apparel
concept.rationale: Halloween is 8-9 weeks from today, hitting the buying window perfectly. Cat plus Halloween is evergreen but the humorous self-referential twist adds differentiation. High gift purchase potential.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "This Is My Costume" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a black cat sitting inside a carved jack-o-lantern pumpkin. The cat's silhouette is solid black with two bright yellow circular eyes glowing from within the pumpkin. The pumpkin is bright orange with a classic carved face (triangular eyes, triangular nose, wide grin). Bold simple shapes, clean sharp edges, screen-print aesthetic. Solid color blocks only: black, bright orange, yellow, and cream. No gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Single centered composition on a plain cream background with generous margins. The design is self-contained and readable from across a room at 12x16 inches.
design.style: Bold spooky serif font arched below the pumpkin illustration, uppercase, high contrast with the cream background

verdict.reason: The phrase 'This Is My Costume' is a common generic humorous expression with no known trademark associations. The visual elements — a black cat inside a jack-o-lantern — are entirely generic Halloween imagery not associated with any specific brand, character, or IP. The spooky serif font styling is a common design convention for Halloween themes. No celebrity likenesses, brand names, registered characters, or protected slogans are present. This design poses minimal IP risk for print-on-demand use.

image_verdict.reason: Text reads 'THIS IS MY COSTUME' exactly as required, correctly spelled and complete. The artwork is a clean, original illustration of a black cat sitting inside a jack-o'-lantern pumpkin — a generic Halloween motif with no IP concerns. The illustration style is flat vector with no anatomical issues, no garbled elements, no artifacts, and a clean light background suitable for garment printing.

listing.title: Black Cat Halloween Shirt - 'This Is My Costume' Jack-O-Lantern Tee
listing.description: A witty pick for cat lovers who celebrate Halloween. Featuring a black cat cozily nestled inside a carved jack-o-lantern with the phrase 'This Is My Costume' below, this tee combines pet humor with seasonal charm. Perfect as a Halloween costume alternative, gift for cat owners, or festive daily wear during autumn months. The spooky serif font adds playful character without trying too hard.
